summary.text: John Contreni Jr. is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican James White.
Contreni is a historian who was a college professor and lives in Greenville.

paragraphs.text: John Contreni Jr. earned a high school diploma from St. Cecilia High School, a bachelor's degree from Saint Vincent College in 1966 and a Ph.D. from Michigan State University in 1971.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was a historian and a professor at Purdue University for 45 years.
Contreni said in the survey that he and his wife bought a home in Maine in 2006 and live in Greenville.

He listed municipal experience as a key message, including chairing the Greenville Planning Board, serving on the town's budget and comprehensive plan committees, and serving as a trustee of the Shaw Public Library and of the Moosehead Outdoor Alliance.
